name: lpk-dev
description: Local development marketplace for the lpk and drawio plugins.

plugins.name: lpk
plugins.description: One coding request to a delivered change: facts first, a design checked against the code, test-first build with exact self-checks, then proof on the running surface and a tech-lead review on the same commit. Plus a rule catalog, the lpk Chrome DevTools server and a push guard.

plugins.name: drawio
plugins.description: Technical diagrams and charts as editable draw.io files plus PNG in one signature style, flat or isometric, where tones carry meaning and accents group.
